body:
VELA's sharing and recovery paths need authenticated context, durable state updates, and security claims external researchers can reproduce. This PR adds recipient-bound hybrid-signed v2 share envelopes, both-key enrollment fingerprints, a transcript-bound v2 KEM combiner, generation-checked recoverable share commits, and an assurance package with claims, adversaries, implementation mappings, pinned tools, evidence and remaining obligations.

Production Rust policy kernels and selected parser/crypto helpers are extracted through pinned hax and checked by F★. Handlers construct facts from observed rows, decoded inputs and consumed grants. Enrollment preflight has a separate ranked ordering specification and bidirectional readiness lemmas. Final enrollment authorization uses the actual consumed/matching grant. Linked-share handlers call policy decisions before guarded SQL writes. Sharing inbox arithmetic uses bounded subtraction and agrees with a widened sum specification, including i64 extremes.

Mobile downloads now require sealed authenticated chunks, positive matching integer epochs and the verified chunk policy. Accepted clocks advance namespaced server/account/epoch floors only after local persistence. Android fixes reject hostile re-auth account changes, missing pins, stale identity responses and failed identity writes; token collection and retry acceptance use a shared production controller. Identity/RMS/settings updates are serialized. Vault replacement uses a temporary file, data fsync and atomic rename; parent-directory durability is not claimed. Legacy unsealed migration is not implemented, and pre-upgrade floors cannot be migrated to an authenticated namespace, so the first post-upgrade sync is explicit first contact.

Ten CryptoVerif games provide nine scoped positive results and an explicit legacy nonproof control: v2 hybrid KEM, modular KEM-DEM, AND-signatures, RMS possession proofs and authenticated Shamir reconstruction. Random-oracle, group/encoding, concrete KDF, multi-user/quantum and Rust/game correspondence assumptions remain documented. These results do not compose into a whole-system theorem.

M28 checks ten journal results and M29 eleven composition results. A separate handwritten F★ development proves all-pairs pin/generation goals on typed initialized single-slot encodings, checks lift/projection, and supplies a unary proper-subterm instance and reachable two-commit witness. Pin non-vacuity uses distinct clear events; generation uniqueness is instantiated reflexively. Tamarin source embeddings, its full term algebra, global freshness/interleavings and Rust/filesystem refinement remain open.

Validation:

- **249 explicit Rust/F★ postconditions /256 selected functions across 14 artifacts**, with zero local assume-val declarations. Seven selected helpers lack direct ensures. Imported models and proof tools remain trusted.
- Separately counted handwritten proofs: **20 universal chunk-admission lemmas**, **six epoch lemmas**, and the encoded journal development. The chunk theorem is about the actual extracted planner, conditional on AAD/epoch facts; the integer epoch kernel checks positivity and equality.
- Fresh local pinned extraction/F★ checks pass. Parent tests: **162 Android JVM tests**, **28 Android Rust bridge tests**, **18 Apple Rust bridge tests**. JVM auth tests use fake HTTP and production controller/authenticator components; they do not execute the full manager/recovery lifecycle, JNI or Android instrumentation.
- Focused internal reviews found no code blockers in the final mobile corrections and accepted the scoped chunk/journal proofs. These were internal static reviews, not external audits. Hosted macOS compiled Swift and ran 90 tests on `093d6ab`: 89 passed; the decode-failure test stopped while creating an invalid fixture. The current head corrects the fixture to reach decoding after successful admission and awaits hosted rerun. Swift cannot be run locally on this Linux host.
- Recovery has 90 contracts, seven policy unit/eight enumeration tests; retained server snapshots include 64 integration tests, 57 library tests and three lifecycle tests. Bounded real-handler sharing/recovery conformance tests are finite executable checks, not unbounded trace refinements.
- Source/model correspondence hashes, assurance manifest, proof boundary and workflow lint pass locally. Heavy local verification is serialized under the 3 GiB/no-swap/one-worker cap.

**All 15 checks passed on prior head 25bf944**, including [security workflow 40110664470](https://github.com/lucannez64/VELA/actions/runs/40110664470), reproducing 245 Rust contracts and twenty chunk lemmas. **The current head adds the reviewed mobile and encoded journal increments; its hosted checks are pending.** Evidence retains each snapshot's original provenance/counts.

Full-system formalization remains incomplete under the selected OS/compiler and primitive-security boundary. Open obligations include SQL/store/decoder/verifier origins; complete exception, concurrency and crash traces; byte/open/FFI correspondence; native storage and Swift/Kotlin behavior; and joint protocol/computational composition. Grant authority uses commitment presence rather than exact commitment/generation binding or permanent revocation across restaging. iOS baseline storage assumes one syncing writer process; concurrent processes can lose/lower floors. A captured RMS may finish after lock, and token bootstrap/intermediate rotations are outside the controller's operation-level acceptance guarantee. Residual coverage, retry/idempotency and exceptional RMS cleanup limits are explicitly documented.

This PR remains draft and unmerged. No independent external audit or researcher outreach is claimed.
